title: Affine-open adjoining step for perfect Hom continuity
statement: Let $I$ be a preordered set, $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram, $c$ a cocone, $i\in I$, and $s:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$ a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme]. Assume the scheme derived categories of [def-pc-derived-category] exist. In addition, suppose $I$ is directed, $c$ is colimiting, and $s$ is locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Let $U,V\subseteq X$ be opens, with $U$ quasi-compact and $V$ affine. If the conditions $\mathcal C(U)$, $\mathcal C(V)$ and $\mathcal C(U\cap V)$ of [def-pc-perfect-hom-continuity-on] hold, then $\mathcal C(U\cup V)$ holds.

proof.text: If U≤V then U⊔V=V and hcontV proves the conclusion; if V≤U then U⊔V=U and hcontU proves it. This includes adjoining an empty open. Otherwise use the following comparison argument.

For any presenting open immersion and perfect pair, obtain the pinned five-term diagram from lem-pc-perfect-hom-mayer-vietoris-comparison. Apply Mathlib's five lemma to its exact rows and four invertible neighbours. Compose the resulting central bijection with a and b.

proof.text: For surjectivity above j₀, lift the limit morphism through the central bijection. Represent the resulting filtered-colimit element at a stage j. Directedness supplies k≥j,j₀. Transport its representative using H.map; cocone naturality and the pinned central equation give exactly the desired perfectLimitMap equality.

source.place: Tag 09RE, Mayer--Vietoris induction step; Cohomology Tag 08BW; online source checked 2026-10-13

proof.text: For eventual equality, central injectivity and the pinned equation show equality of the two representatives in d.pt. The filtered-set colimit equality criterion gives an arrow j→k with equal H-images. For every l≥k apply H.map(k→l), use the functor composition law, and apply ident_l and its pinned transition equation. This yields perfectStageMap equality throughout the later tail.
